patch.name: Premium unlock
patch.version_policy: Intentionally version-unpinned; package-scoped, not Universal; Hermes version 96 and required named on-check signatures remain runtime guards.
patch.description_before: Unlocks Plex Pass features client-side (auto Skip Intros, downloads, ...) and makes the patched output sideload-installable on any device (strips split-install constraints).
patch.description_after: Changes client-side Plex Pass checks in supported Hermes v96 bundles and optionally removes decoded-manifest split constraints. Does not grant server-side entitlements or guarantee device compatibility.

behavior: No algorithm, guard, manifest cleanup, footer or default changes. Production helper remains private; tests use the actual public Morphe resource context and patch execute API if supported, not a copied algorithm.
limitations: Linear register tracking is not CFG analysis; false matches across branches and conservative register-write assumptions remain donor risks.
Parser is a minimal Hermes96 reader, not a comprehensive hostile-input validator; existing integer/bounds/footer limitations are preserved.
Production does not validate the original SHA-1 footer before editing; idempotent input with a bad footer is not repaired.
Historical phone/TV notes are untrusted prior claims, not newly observed runtime acceptance.
Generic bytecode apply/assembly intentionally rejects actual resource edits and must not be weakened for Plex.
No vendor APK/APKM or donor MPP copied, signed, installed or executed; no collection MPP/Manager/device acceptance established.

Static javap inspection of pinned Morphe2.3.0 shows ResourcePatchContext construction reads package metadata and get(AndroidManifest.xml) invokes on-demand manifest decoding. Donor comments claiming the manifest normally remains binary are historical and not proof of current API behavior; tests explicitly stage missing/binary/text cases after a real synthetic binary-manifest decode.

tests.runner_contract: Python -I -B; explicit installed JDK and pinned compiler/runtime/JUnit cache; NEW external output; no downloads, stubs, generic-apply changes or production helper extraction.
coverage_intent: Hermes96 header, magic, version, file/count/section bounds, ASCII/UTF16/overflow/duplicate strings, compact/full function headers, operand widths, signed branches, switch tables, malformed instructions and SHA1 footer

Actual production rawResourcePatch execute with real Morphe resource context and self-authored binary manifest, all six strict flip forms, exact opcode/footer delta, decoys, idempotence, mixed pending sites, register moves/clobbers and duplicate function names
Missing required strings/functions/checks and malformed input before any patch write; optional staged manifest branches and unchanged files on preflight failure
